title_zh: 决定先要求赞助方取消发言稿审批条件

scenario.label_zh: 决定先要求赞助方取消发言稿审批条件
scenario.goal_zh: 说明社团对赞助条件的分歧，并决定先要求保留独立发言权而不立即接受资助

context_zh: 虚构社区社团讨论企业提出的活动赞助条件。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: There's a split in the committee over this offer. Half of us want the money; the others dislike the conditions.

sentences.speaker: Karim
sentences.text: What exactly does the sponsor want?

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: A logo on the programme, which seems fine, but also the right to approve every speech.

sentences.speaker: Karim
sentences.text: Our stance should be clear: sponsorship doesn't buy control over what members say.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Then should we reject the whole offer?

sentences.speaker: Karim
sentences.text: Let's first ask them to remove the speech-approval condition. We can keep the logo arrangement on the table.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll send that request, but I won't accept the funding on the club's behalf.

sentences.speaker: Karim
sentences.text: Good. We'll bring their response back to the committee.
